title: Pickleball Sunday
style: 118 bpm, breezy summer funk, surf guitar, organ stabs, soft brass, hand percussion, crowd ambience, male lead with female harmonies, easygoing, sun-drenched, joyful no-pressure groove
lyrics:
[Intro - surf guitar, organ, distant crowd ambience]
Paddle in the hand, sun on the court
No VDS today, no Linear report

[Verse 1 - Male Lead, breezy]
Closed the laptop Friday night
The workshop's still humming, the eight blue lights bright
ORICO can spin without me on the chair
Three thirty six can wait — I got fresh air
White shoes, green court, yellow ball bouncing low
No bots, no comments, just the people I know

[Pre-Chorus - Female harmony]
The operator gets a Sunday
The operator gets a break
No CLI, no compile, no upload at stake
Just paddle, just net, just laugh, just play
Pickleball Sunday, the slow easy way

[Chorus - duet, warm]
Pickleball Sunday, the workshop can rest
Pickleball Sunday, the operator at his best
The family in the bleachers, Pete cheering me on
Pickleball Sunday, no machine, just the sun
Pickleball Sunday, light on the court
Pickleball Sunday, the kind of report
That doesn't go in Linear, doesn't sit in Notion Hub
Just laughs in the parking lot, ice in the cup

[Verse 2 - Female Lead]
Not everything's a track, not everything's a code
Some days the operator just walks down the road
The band can wait, La Banda's at the patio
Rafa knows the rhythm of the resting tempo
Three thirty six is still the count, but slower today
The heart's still in tune, just easier to play

[Bridge - acoustic break, hand percussion]
Serve. Volley. Laugh. Repeat.
Serve. Volley. Laugh. Repeat.
No machines between us, just paddle and feet.

[Final Chorus - big harmonies, summer]
Pickleball Sunday — the workshop can rest
Pickleball Sunday — the operator's blessed
Three thirty six in the breeze, the sun on the lawn
Pickleball Sunday — still the song, still the song

[Outro - surf guitar fade, distant laughter]
Pickleball Sunday...
The workshop holds...
The operator smiles...
The story still rolls...
